ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Assassin: Killing is a job, and killing for money is the ultimate job. There is no life that you can’t put a price on. Code of Honor: Bolt is loyal if he feels he’s being treated fairly by his employer, even in the face of jail time. However, if he feels his employer is lying to him or otherwise mistreating him, he’ll teleport out in the middle of a job and the employer may become his new target! Greed: Bolt works for money, lots of money. If you pay, he’ll play, but if the money dries up he takes off. the Killer Elite, and has been a member of both the Secret So - ciety of Super-Villains and the Injustice League. He would not consider any members of these groups to be allies.
